title: Desk Guidance on Handling and Conditioning Charges Under Storage Agreements
content:
Handling charges under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements are separate from storage rent and are raised on the service actually performed. This guidance states what is charged, on what quantity, and how a component the programme does not carry is shown.

## Guidance

1. Elevation in is charged on the bushels of each load taken in, elevation out on the bushels of each load-out, and both are taken at the programme's rate per bushel.

2. Aeration and turning are charged per bushel per cycle unless the programme carries them, and on a programme that carries them no aeration or turning charge is ever raised however many cycles the bin takes.

3. Segregation is charged per bushel on programmes that keep a lot out of the house bin, and it is charged once on the bushels taken in rather than repeatedly while they sit.

4. Issuing a warehouse receipt is charged at the programme's issuance fee and cancelling one at the cancellation fee, and neither is charged on programmes that do not issue receipts at all.

5. Handling charges stack with storage rent rather than replacing it, and a component the programme does not carry is not zero but simply not applicable, so it is never shown as a nil line on the statement.

## The quantity each charge is taken on

| Service | Quantity it is taken on | How often |
| --- | --- | --- |
| elevation in | the bushels of the load taken in | once for each load |
| elevation out | the bushels of the load-out | once for each load-out |
| aeration | the bushels of the cycle | once for each cycle, where the programme does not carry it |
| turning | the bushels of the cycle | once for each cycle, where the programme does not carry it |
| segregation | the bushels taken in | once, on the bushels taken in |
| receipt issuance | the receipt | once, where the programme issues receipts |
| receipt cancellation | the receipt | once, where the programme issues receipts |

## Notes for the desk

**A bin on a programme that carries aeration takes four cycles over the winter.** No aeration charge is raised at all, the programme carrying it however many cycles the bin takes.

**A segregated lot sits from harvest through the following summer.** Segregation was charged once on the bushels taken in; it is not raised again for the months the lot sits.

**A member on a programme that issues no receipts asks why no receipt charge appears on the statement.** The component is not carried by that programme, so it is not applicable rather than nil, and no line for it appears.

**Does a handling charge take the place of storage rent for the period it falls in?** It does not. Handling stacks with rent; both stand on the account.
